product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice 30W LED DMX Spot Moving Head Stage Light with 7 Colors and Gobos
product.description: Project a crisp beam of light anywhere with this 30‑watt moving head stage light. Choose from 7 colors, plus open white, and 7 gobos patterns, plus an open circle. Super‑fast servo motors and 16‑bit fine tuners direct light where you want when you want. If programming is not your speed, then take it out of DMX mode and activate any of the 8 auto programs or the sound active mode with internal mic. With one unit serving as the master, up to 32 additional units can slave together for an incredible light show all night long.Features: Uses a single, 30‑watt white LED8‑position gobo wheel with 7 gobo patterns and a non‑template open beam option8‑position color wheel with 7 color filters (Orange, Cyan, Lavender, Yellow, Green, Blue, and Red) and a non‑filtered Open/White option8 built‑in programs9‑channel and 12‑channel DMX control modes540° of pan movement, 190° of tilt movementReversible Pan and Tilt control for inverted or mirrored operationReversible menu for inverted operationIncludes sound‑responsive programAccepts 100 ~ 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz input powerSupport Files: User's Manual (Nov 17, 2021)Monoprice™, Stage Right™, the Stage Right logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
